name: Fifth Third Bancorp
description: Fifth Third is a Midwest and Southeast regional bank with $214B in assets and 1,130 branches in 12 states at Dec 31, 2025. It collects deposits and lends to companies and households, earning most of its income from interest, and it is strong in payments services for businesses (commercial payments revenue $553M in 2025). On February 1, 2026 it closed an all-stock merger with Comerica valued at about $12.7B, which makes the FY2025 numbers below pre-merger and roughly comparable only to the old Fifth Third. Net income was $2,522M in 2025 and return on average tangible common equity was 17.4% (a non-GAAP measure).

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge, not re-checked. SEC SIC code is 6022 (State Commercial Banks). Chosen as the regional-bank example because the Comerica merger changed its size in 2026.
